strip-golden-chase.about: The default start at golden hour from the mid chase camera.

strip-golden-cockpit.about: The default start at golden hour from the driver's seat.

strip-night-cockpit.about: The default start at night with the headlights on, from the driver's seat.

town-noon-wagon.about: The wagon on a residential street at noon from the far chase camera.

strip-dusk-near.about: Dusk on the strip just after the street lamps come on (sun 7° down), headlights on, from the near chase camera.

town-map-full.about: The full-screen map at the default start: the whole town north-up with the player arrow.

coast-strip-golden.about: The procedural coast streamed round the strip's densest run of neon (the most neon signs within 60 m ahead of any lane point) at golden hour from the far chase camera: the resident ring, the far terrain's hills behind it.

coast-traffic-noon.about: Busy NPC traffic at a signalized junction on the coast at noon, from the mid chase camera 35 m back from the stop line on a red, a car stopped beside it and the lights ahead (phase=1440), and the busy pedestrians that come with it: a few people on the walks toward the beach (traffic warmed up 20 s before the frame, people 60 s).

coast-peds-noon.about: Busy pedestrians on the coast's busiest block at noon, from the mid chase camera on the road: people walking, standing about and in groups on both walks (the crowd warmed up 60 s before the frame).

coast-beach-lot-noon.about: A beach lot on the coast at noon, near its fullest, from the far chase camera on the ocean front: stalls along both sides, islands with palms, light poles, wheel stops and painted stripes.

coast-night-golden.about: The procedural coast's strip at night from the near chase camera, headlights on: sodium lamps with coronas, neon sign bands and blade signs, shop fills on the walks.

coast-edge-sea.about: Out to sea from the beach beside the pier at golden hour, far chase camera: the open ocean to a real horizon, the surf on the waterline, the headlands of the north and south walls framing the bay.

coast-edge-ridges.about: East from the south end of the strip up a local street at golden hour, far chase camera: the town under the hills rising into the eastern mountain ridges, fading into the haze.

coast-traffic-night.about: Busy NPC traffic at the signalized junction of coast-traffic-noon at night, headlights on, from the mid chase camera 35 m back from the stop line: NPC low beams with coronas, glowing lamps (traffic warmed up 20 s before the frame).

coast-traffic-dusk-chase.about: Busy NPC traffic on the pier's avenue at dusk from the mid chase camera, in the outer eastbound lane heading inland (traffic warmed up 20 s before the frame).

vehicle-select.about: The pause menu's Vehicle page (at golden hour, which the studio does not show): the Regent on the turntable in the studio beside the panel, its paint swatches and specs.

basin-boulevard-night.about: Mirage Bowl (the mirage_bowl layout) at night on the boulevard: the eastbound carriageway, the palm median and its lamps, the mini-malls, from the far chase camera.

basin-boulevard-afternoon.about: Mirage Bowl's boulevard at 15:30 from the far chase camera, as basin-boulevard-night: the filler kept quiet (no names on the shops' sign bands, only bare stucco, plain fascias and mural walls; stepped and shaped parapets), the blade neon the only signs.

basin-channel-golden.about: Mirage Bowl's wash at golden hour from its bed: the concrete trapezoid and its low-flow strip, looking down it toward the freeway's bridge, from the far chase camera.

basin-drive-thru-noon.about: Mirage Bowl's donut shop drive-thru at noon from the near chase camera: the car stopped in the lane with its driver's door at the window (donut=1.1: the serve 1.1 s in), the person inside leaning out over the sill holding the pink box out to it.

basin-freeway-night.about: Mirage Bowl's freeway at night, eastbound across the floor toward downtown's towers: the streets' overpasses ahead, the lamps of the grid either side, from the far chase camera.

basin-hills-night.about: Mirage Bowl from the lookout at the end of the observatory road at night: its turnout's guard rail, benches and lamp, the lit grid and downtown below, from the far chase camera.

basin-garage-night.about: Mirage Bowl's crew garage at night from the far chase camera on the summit avenue before it: three open bays lit by their tubes, two hero cars nosed out in the outer bays and one angled on the apron, the backlit box sign over the bays lettered from the 2001 lexicon.

basin-crossing-train.about: Mirage Bowl's grade crossing on an arterial at dusk with the freight train across it (102 s into a run), from the mid chase camera stopped on the approach: both gates' arms down in red and white bands, the near mast's lamp lit, the train's boxcars, tank cars and hoppers on the track.

basin-boulevard-dusk-wave.about: Mirage Bowl's boulevard at dusk, 12 s into the street lamps' wave (civil dusk at 18:30:43), eastbound toward where it started: the median's lamps lit in the blocks ahead, striking or still dark in the near ones, signs at their own moments, from the far chase camera.

basin-palace-night.about: Mirage Bowl's movie palace at night from the far chase camera, northbound on the summit avenue downtown (a downtown anchor, variant A, the owner's pick): the marquee's lit boards and dim bulbs (the chasing third lit, frozen at the clock's phase), the blade sign lettered THEATRE in neon over it.

basin-city-hall-golden.about: Mirage Bowl's boulevard at golden hour from the far chase camera, eastbound toward its end: the city hall (a downtown anchor, variant B: its clock tower over the arcade) closing the view across the T at the east avenue.

basin-letters-golden.about: Mirage Bowl's hillside letters at golden hour from the far chase camera, north up the summit avenue, which points at them (a terminated vista, docs/WORLD_GENERATION.md "Vistas"): MIRAGE in white sheet-metal letters on the slope above the foothill houses, closing the view.

basin-water-tower-noon.about: Mirage Bowl's water tower at noon from the far chase camera, east down the yard road toward it: the sky-blue pedestal tower (variant B) over the warehouses and their parked cars.

coast-dawn-haze.about: Dawn on the coast (05:50, just before sunrise) east up a local street toward the ridges from the far chase camera, the sky lightening behind them.
